name: Olist marketplace
story: A Brazilian online marketplace where independent sellers list products and Olist handles orders, payments and delivery. About 99k orders from Sep 2016 to Oct 2018.

name: Toy store web analytics
story: An online toy store (Maven Fuzzy Factory) selling four stuffed-animal products. Every website session, pageview, order and refund from Mar 2012 to Mar 2015, with paid search and social campaigns.

name: SaaS subscriptions
story: RavenStack, a B2B SaaS startup selling AI team tools on Basic, Pro and Enterprise plans. Accounts, subscriptions, product usage, support and churn from 2023 to 2024. Fully synthetic.

name: Satellite autonomy ops
story: A 9-person spacecraft autonomy startup with 5 contracts; its onboard software and camera modules fly on 44 customer satellites, from a 4-cubesat swarm to GEO servicers. Onboard object detections, conjunctions, avoidance maneuvers and navigation health from Mar 2025 to Oct 2026. Fully synthetic.
